convert_data2vec_audio_checkpoint: convert a fairseq data2vec audio checkpoint to a Hugging Face transformers model
convert_data2vec_audio_unfinetuned_check: convert an unfinetuned fairseq data2vec audio checkpoint to a Hugging Face transformers model
recursively_load_weights: recursively load fairseq model weights into a Hugging Face data2vec audio model
load_conv_layer: load convolutional layer weights from a fairseq checkpoint into a data2vec feature extractor
load_pos_conv_layer: load positional convolution layer weights from a fairseq checkpoint into a data2vec model
